div.p: Judgment use (BPHS / Raman "How to Judge a Horoscope" p.14, p.20): a bhava/topic is judged from house + its lord + its occupants + its Karaka, and each of those four is weighed by its strength & Avastha (see planetary-avasthas.d2).

g.text: NirayanaLongitudeDegrees (float, NOT NULL, every chart type)

div.p: Which planet rules each bhava (Whole Sign, from Lagna).

ul.li: Stored: tbl_Chart_HouseLords (1-12 per chart type) — sign, lord, lord's 3x house, lord's sign, lord's dignity

div.p: Vimshottari dasa lord of the nakshatra the planet occupies (+ KP sub-lord).

ul.li: Stored: tbl_Chart_KeyDetails.NakshatraLordPlanet, .NakshatraSubLordPlanet — every chart type (real-longitude fact)

div.p: Functional benefic / malefic / neutral / yogakaraka per Lagna (from house-lordship).

ul.li: Engine: Core/Calculators/LagnaFunctionalNature.For(lagnaSign, planet) -> FunctionalNatureResult { Nature, RuledHouses, IsMaraka, KendradhipatiDosha, Rationale }
Surfaced only in the Web D1 planet table; no persisted column (the Raman mirror tbl_Dim_LagnaFunctionalNature was removed 2026-08-31)

div.p: Fixed/natural significators (Sun=father/self, Moon=mother/mind, Mars=siblings, Mercury=speech, Jupiter=children/wealth, Venus=spouse, Saturn=longevity/grief).

ul.li: Hardcoded subset in Core/LifeAreas/LifeAreaMap.cs (Karakas per life-area)
Not a data table — migration 030 (tbl_Dim_PlanetHouseKaraka / tbl_Dim_PlanetSignification) is DESIGNED but NOT applied (docs/house-lagna-significations.md)
Sapta (7) vs Ashta (8) count convention: undecided

div.p: Jaimini 8-fold movable karakas — AK, AmK, BK, MK, PK, GK, DK (+ variant 8th), planets ranked by degrees-within-sign descending (Rahu reversed).

ul.li: Feeds Karakamsa + every Jaimini rasi dasa (key_comp_astro.md Tier-1 #3)
